Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md (symlinks, path traversal, malformed records, races, signals, size limits, error paths) is required as a ## Hardening section in every worker brief (preflight or brief-check refuses a brief without it) and is passed to krn review via --prepass --checklist in every delivery; an observer is red at base. Root cause of 48% of lost review attempts (lens-quality.md).
Evidence: .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md (operator grant ./grant.md, 2026-11-01).

title: Add empty and root-resolving arguments to the hardening checklist

Outcome: docs/program/hardening-checklist.md names argument inputs: an empty argument, ".", "..", an absolute path or a symlink that resolves to an ancestor of the intended root is refused, never widened into a larger selection; krn brief check keeps accepting the existing classes (extend `malformed` or add one class, with the brief-hardening tests updated).

title: Deliver completes hygiene when only the CI final reset failed
body:
Outcome: krn deliver finishes hygiene when the merged head's krn/gate reports gate=true but only the Jenkins final reset failed, and reports the infra failure separately (exit and task pointer).
Evidence: PR #164 deliver exited 74 on main 8961311 ('Final reset failed; quarantine remains', gate=true); the lead redid hygiene by hand from src/deliver/delivery.ts:734-780 (review-series archive, worktree remove, ff main, branch delete), then archived orphaned runs.

title: Run two independent lead slices in parallel
body:
Outcome: two lead sessions run independent slices in parallel within the host cap of 2 deliveries, under the "Parallel lanes" rule in docs/program/lead-rules.md.
Scope narrowed 2026-11-02 by the lead under the blanket grant: the second Jenkins executor and the before/after throughput measurement moved to t-vgd1bp3, because measured queue wait is about 3 min per PR against a 49 min median open-to-merge (n=40) and a second runner needs a VM pool on a PVE host this lead cannot reach.

title: Ship review-record schema changes and print deliver ship refusals
body:
Outcome: a change to the review record schema can ship with its own review record. krn ship verifies records with the trusted base schema, so a record using a new field (PR #170: prior.source, role 'prepass') is refused ('review record does not satisfy the strict schema', ship --dry-run exit 1) and the PR needs an extra review attempt run in the old shape. Also: krn deliver exited 76 with empty stdout and stderr instead of printing the ship refusal.
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/prepass-prior/deliver.exit (76), deliver.out (0 bytes); hand ship --dry-run printed the refusal.
Lead trap: when a PR changes the review record schema, run its last review attempt in the base record shape (no new fields) under a budget exception; when deliver exits 76 silently, run krn ship --dry-run by hand to read the refusal.

After a new head, krn deliver resumes stale state and exits 71 "bind: record/PR head mismatch"; workaround in krn-lead step 8: delete .krn/runs/deliver/<series>/{state.json,review.json,merge-message.txt} and rerun (seen on #170).
